purpose: Canonical project memory shared by Claude, GPT, Copilot, and human contributors.

files.project.json: Stable product goal, proposed architecture, constraints, and open questions.
files.research.json: Externally verified facts with dates, sources, confidence, and implications.
files.decisions.json: Accepted, proposed, rejected, and superseded product or architecture decisions.
files.progress.json: Current phase, completed work, blockers, next steps, and milestone history.

update_protocol: Update progress.json after every meaningful milestone or newly confirmed blocker.
Append decisions rather than rewriting history; mark replaced entries as superseded.
Add research only with a source URL and verification timestamp.
Mark a decision accepted only after explicit user agreement or implementation evidence.
Keep volatile status out of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
Do not store secrets or private workspace content.
